purpose: ff/fi/fl/ffi/ffl ligature words: TeX substitutes ligature glyphs, changing advance widths and line breaks.
notes: Word dx accumulates by the ligature width difference per occurrence; PDFKit may extract ligatures as U+FB00-FB04 (folded by the word normaliser).
page_size: US letter 612x792pt (geometry default paper for article is letterpaper)
preamble_policy: engine-specific apples-to-apples preamble is substituted by the harness; FlashTeX gets the body only
